messages:
amanda: FYI escalated from ACME — their project admins lost console access after an Okta group merge, getting 403 on project switch. API keys and CLI still work. Can ENG/SRE triage?
raj: Can you paste the console network error + request-id and the tenant/project ids?
amanda: tenant: acme-corp, project id: proj_0123 (acme-prod-1). User: alice@acme.com. Console overlay shows '403 Permission denied' when switching projects. Network panel: GET /api/projects/proj_0123/switch -> 403. Response headers include x-request-id: req_0a9f8c3b. Pasting minimal repro we ran from support session:
```
# repro using user's cookie session we were able to reproduce locally
curl -i -H "Cookie: session=ey.." \"https://console.redwood.ai/api/projects/proj_0123/switch\"
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "reason": "user_missing_role"
}
```
amanda: Note: same user can call hosted API endpoints with their API key (generates tokens) and act in project via API calls, so authn works, but console UI flow (project switch) is failing authorization. :thinking_face:
matt: :eyes: That pattern usually means the OIDC/SCIM claim we rely on for console RBAC got altered during the Okta group merge. Did the customer mention merging two groups into one?
amanda: Yes, ACME's Okta admin merged groups 'prod-admins' + 'contractors' into a new group 'prod-admins'. They confirmed a SCIM bulk update went out right after. Affected users are those who were in both original groups.
ciara: Please grab the server authz decision log for x-request-id=req_0a9f8c3b — we log the resolved role claim used for the decision. Need the claim payload we received from IdP at the time of login.
amanda: Pasting the small excerpt the customer shared (sanitized):
```
{
  "sub": "alice@acme.com",
  "idp_claims": {
    "groups": ["prod-admins"],
    "roles": ["member"]  # expected project_admin, but appears downgraded
  },
  "scim_event_id": "evt_98765",
  "received_at": "2026-02-28T14:12:03Z"
}
```
amanda: Customer says before merge roles array included project_admin for this user. After merge only 'member' present.
matt: That points to two possibilities: (1) SCIM delta from Okta included a partial member list and our SCIM processor deduped/overwrote role mapping incorrectly during the merge, or (2) Okta's claim transform mapped merged group to a different Okta group id and our service-mapper translation returns only default role.
raj: For short-term help for the customer, can we rebind the project_admin role server-side while we triage so they can continue working?
ciara: Yes — we can run an admin rebind job for affected principals. Quick workaround (manual):
```
# admin API to bind a role to a principal
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/admin/v1/projects/proj_0123/roles/bind" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"principal": "alice@acme.com", "role": "project_admin"}'
```
ciara: I'll queue a one-off job to rebind all users who show the 'claim_truncated' marker in the SCIM event. Need support to authorize and confirm impacted list.
amanda: I have a CSV from the customer with ~14 users affected, sent to security@redwood for approval. They ran a 'Resync identity providers' from the console already — no change.
matt: I'll start a root-cause investigation: checking SCIM ingestion code path for bulk merges (notably our handling of large membership deltas). If Okta sends a merged group with a very large members array we may hit our truncation limit when composing the role claim. Also checking our service-mapper rule that maps Okta group names to roles.
ciara: Opening an internal incident I-2026-0317-SCIMMERGE. Short plan: (1) run manual rebind for immediate access, (2) reproduce merge locally with a staged Okta tenant import, (3) patch SCIM batch processor to avoid overwriting richer role sets with smaller incoming lists, (4) backfill any affected sessions. ETA for manual rebind: ~40m.
deploy-bot: Started job "scim/rebind-quickfix" at 1789500045, job id job_7742 — will post logs when finished.
amanda: I'll tell ACME we have a temporary rebind plan and will update within the hour. Account will offer admin invite link if they prefer.
account-sam: I'll coordinate comms and request a permission for us to run the rebind on their tenant. Also asking whether we should offer credits for disruption.
matt: After I reproduce, expect a small code fix + migration. Will include a regression test for group-merge cases.
ciara: For triage owners: matt (eng) / ciara (sre) / amanda (support). I'll attach the incident and assign.
raj: Thanks — please paste final job logs and the authz decision after rebind so we can confirm.
amanda: Will update here with req_0a9f8c3b resolution and job logs. :thumbsup:
